Sudden Raid's requirements are quite heavy.
While it is recommended to stick to the best scoring team for farming, if you face issues with the team listed, feel free to use the alternative heroes listed to get a smoother/more consistent run with no scoring concerns. Ultimately, for majority of players, this is a farming mode rather than a competitive one. The videos also illustrate how to use the possible alternatives.

column7:
Main DPS should not be in the backline as Astrea inflicts [All ATK Reduction] on backline. So save the time on needing to cleanse.
You can stack SPD on Support units to outspeed Astrea's SPD of 240 for quicker runs (and higher score). And in this case, Skill Queue will be tweaked so that Espada's S1 goes first.
Astrea has 0 DEF so DEF Reduction is pointless.

If limited by gear, just make sure that Bai Long is using Assassin.
If Guan Yu has survival issues, use either Guts ring or Gatekeeper set.
If Lu Bu is not T6, push Xiao's still to Priority 4 instead.
